public_payload.instruction: Exchange item_a in slot_left and item_b in slot_right. Each slot holds at most one item. Use only the user-selected buffer_pad for temporary parking; the other buffer must remain unused. Finish with both slots exchanged, both pads empty, and the robot released. The required buffer_pad is unspecified.

public_payload.instruction: Move the opaque screen onto screen_pad, use the fixed inspection camera to inspect the label underneath, and report its actual code. Leave the label in place and the screen on its pad. The code is a fixed world fact, not a preference. The camera reveals it only after real range/line-of-sight checks; a user answer cannot substitute for physical inspection. No need to ask for a code that can be observed after clearing the screen.
